name: DAY3
recent: DAY3 正在推进一项私募新股计划，拟发行 66,666,000 股认购股（约占已发行股份 11.11%），Bursa Securities 已于 2025 年 11 月 25 日批准其上市。公司同期公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利同比减半，首九个月转为亏损。此外，大股东 BLM Holdings 与 Bernadine Lee Siew Ling 在 10 月至 11 月间有股权变动申报。
notable: Bursa Securities approved the listing of 66,666,000 subscription shares, representing 11.11% of issued shares, under the proposed subscription.。
The company announced a proposed subscription of new shares to raise funds.。
3Q FY2026 net profit halved to RM0.465 million, while the nine-month period swung to a net loss of RM2.651 million.。
risks: The proposed subscription of 66,666,000 new shares represents 11.11% of the existing issued shares, which would dilute existing shareholders' stakes.。
Substantial shareholder BLM Holdings Sdn. Bhd. and Bernadine Lee Siew Ling filed multiple changes in their shareholdings during October and November 2025.。
The company recorded a net loss of RM2.651 million for the nine months of FY2026.。

news.title: Daythree Digital 3Q FY2026 Net Profit Halves to RM0.465 Million as 9M Swings to RM2.651 Million Loss

recent_en: DAY3 is proceeding with a proposed private placement of 66,666,000 subscription shares (about 11.11% of issued shares), with Bursa Securities approving the listing on 25 November 2025. The company also reported 3Q FY2026 results with net profit halving year-on-year and a net loss for the nine-month period. Meanwhile, substantial shareholders BLM Holdings and Bernadine Lee Siew Ling filed changes in their shareholdings in October and November.
notable_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing of 66,666,000 subscription shares, representing 11.11% of issued shares, under the proposed subscription.
The company announced a proposed subscription of new shares to raise funds.
3Q FY2026 net profit halved to RM0.465 million, while the nine-month period swung to a net loss of RM2.651 million.

Substantial shareholder BLM Holdings Sdn. Bhd. and Bernadine Lee Siew Ling filed multiple changes in their shareholdings during October and November 2025.
The company recorded a net loss of RM2.651 million for the nine months of FY2026.
